description: The chart represents the distribution of four categories (N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-) across three difficulty levels (easy, medium, and hard). Each pie chart has four slices, corresponding to the four categories. For the 'easy' chart, the slices are labeled with percentage values and are colored green (N+K+, 40.6%), yellow (N-K+, 45.9%), orange (N-K-, 10.1%), and red (N+K-, 3.3%). The 'medium' chart also has four slices, with percentage values, colored green (N+K+, 44.6%), yellow (N-K+, 44.3%), orange (N-K-, 7.2%), and red (N+K-, 3.9%). The 'hard' chart has slices colored green (N+K+, 36.2%), yellow (N-K+, 36.8%), orange (N-K-, 20.1%), and red (N+K-, 7.0%), with percentage values. A legend on the right side of the chart indicates the color corresponding to each category. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded in any of the charts, and the categories are consistently ordered by color across the three charts.
